figures.caption: Dream Brush is a tangible AI-driven system that turns Chinese calligraphy writing into a Chinese painting.
Dream Brush installation with projector, easel, canvas, and brush.

Example of a session with multiple inscriptions and evolving composition. The user writes "山" (mountain) first, causing a full sized mountain to appear as the main subject, then writes a smaller "日" (sun) at a corner, resulting in the sun to appear in the corresponding size and location.

techQuotes.text: The hardware consists of a metal easel and semi-translucent matte canvas for back-projection, an infrared sensing setup surrounding the canvas for brush detection, a calligraphy brush and cup of water to preserve the feel of brushing without pigment, a speaker for sound, and a computer that coordinates sensing, recognition, generation, and output.
The semi-translucent canvas back-projects the live trace, then lets it fade as if drying.
The canvas shows a back-projected trace of the brushstroke that visibly dries over a few seconds.
On each stroke, the handwritten character is captured as an image and recognized with a vision model.

interactionQuotes.text: We built a physical installation where participants write Chinese characters with water on a canvas and watch the system transform each mark into Chinese painting motifs with sound.
A participant wets a calligraphy brush with water and writes Chinese characters on a physical canvas mounted on an easel.
Dream Brush is a generative AI painting experience where people use a real brush with water to write Chinese characters on a physical canvas mounted on an easel.
